# Bundled fonts

ComfyArt includes web subsets of the following SIL Open Font License 1.1 fonts. The license files in this directory accompany the WOFF2 assets.

| Font | Upstream file | SHA-256 of upstream file |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Noto Sans SC | [NotoSansSC[wght].ttf](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/notosanssc/NotoSansSC%5Bwght%5D.ttf) | `a3041811a78c361b1de50f953c805e0244951c21c5bd412f7232ef0d899af0da` |
| Noto Serif SC | [NotoSerifSC[wght].ttf](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/notoserifsc/NotoSerifSC%5Bwght%5D.ttf) | `050080d9255a86808f2945bffac582b31ef32bc36411ce29563b4961670c66f9` |
| Ma Shan Zheng | [MaShanZheng-Regular.ttf](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/mashanzheng/MaShanZheng-Regular.ttf) | `6d2546bb189c732a8ca29af9e22457b152387d158aa459e4ac2ce1e51788b7fb` |

The WOFF2 subsets retain glyphs present in the upstream file for GB2312, common Big5 characters, Latin letters and punctuation. Noto Sans SC also retains GBK characters for fallback. Each preview subset contains the four characters `春日来信`.
